items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: My first record date ever was with under my name was with Harry Lim. He is the one that sponsored it.

ctx.x: And you also did another record for Coral with Henry Jerome, well a couple of those tracks you redid 'Topsy' and you did 'Big Noise from Winnetka', they were on that cassette that I gave you last night. And that's the last thing that's listed in your discography in the early '60s. Let me just look over for a second. You had been recording under your own name since the early '40s with very small groups.
My first record date ever was with under my name was with Harry Lim. He is the one that sponsored it.

Curiously, that's not listed. The first one listed in Jeffson, it's under the Cozy Cole All Stars in February of '44 with Joe Thomas the trumpeter, Tommy Young, Coleman Hawkins, Earl Hines, Teddy Walters and Billy Taylor.
